summary: Verified new password-reset feature end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (generic forgot-password response for existing & non-existent emails, invalid/tampered/wrong-type/expired token handling, min-length password validation, full E2E reset -> token reuse rejected -> login-with-new-password -> old-password rejected, per-email rate limit hits 429, and full auth regression register/login/me/password-change/session-invalidation). Frontend: Forgot link only shown in login mode (hidden in register), modal opens with email pre-populated from login form and remains editable, submit shows 'Check your inbox' generic confirmation, ResetPasswordView renders on ?reset_token=..., client-side password mismatch and min-length validation work, invalid token returns inline 'This reset link is invalid.' error, URL retains reset_token on failed attempts (stripped only on success by design).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 3000 lines — recommend splitting auth/password-reset into a dedicated module for maintainability.
_dispatch_password_reset_email swallows all exceptions with only a generic warning log (no exception type/stack). Consider logger.exception for observability without leaking to the user.

Reset email link is constructed from the request Origin header (attacker-controllable). If Origin can be spoofed to send victims to a phishing domain in the email body, this could be misused. Consider allow-listing FRONTEND_URL as canonical.
test_credentials: Uses TEST_-prefixed disposable users created via /api/auth/register; admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md not required for this feature.
seed_data_creation: Test module creates TEST_pwreset_* + TEST_rl_* + TEST_reg_* users and cleans them (and their password_reset_tokens) after the module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py. To forge a valid reset token: insert row into password_reset_tokens (id=jti, user_id, email, created_at, expires_at, used_at=None) and sign JWT with backend JWT_SECRET, HS256, payload {sub, email, type:'password_reset', jti, iat, exp}. Rate limits: 5 IP/15min, 3 email/15min for /api/auth/forgot-password; 10/min per IP for /api/auth/reset-password. Rate-limit test may cause subsequent forgot-password calls to 429 for ~15 min under the same IP — isolate with fresh emails.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Only self-inflicted test bug (case-sensitive email comparison) fixed by lowercasing in assertion since backend normalises emails to lowercase.
